newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan allows re-evaluation on business assets.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan allows re-evaluation on business assets.

text.p: Taiwan's Finance Ministry said on Thursday that businesses could begin to re-evaluate assets that they had bought before 1979.
Taiwan's consumer prices have risen more than 25 percent since 1978, a condition that qualifies businesses for asset re-evaluation under the tax law, the ministry said.

The Commercial Times newspaper estimated on Thursday that the re-evaluation would add some 40 percent to business assets bought in 1978, 105 percent to assets bought in 1973 and 201 percent to those bought in 1962.
